text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali chaired a cabinet meeting on public ownership.
- Deputies adopted a law on Tuesday related to the international agreement against taking hostages.
- Government encourages investment in cultural industry.
- Tunisian-Algerian joint talks on boosting cooperation in tourism sector.
- Tunisia and Malta held talks on opportunities of cooperation and partnership.
- An international exhibition for hotel and restaurant equipment starts in Tunis.
